title: What's New in v2.9.26
notes: 👥 Multi-Member Target & Breakdown Parsing: Single-row batch actions (e.g. multi-chief Bear Trap donations) now automatically detect all affected members, display the interactive 'Multiple (N)' pill, show clean hover tooltips with donation amounts, and open the detailed member modal with badges.

latestChanges: v2.9.26: Supported multi-member target & breakdown parsing for single-entry batch logs (such as multi-player Bear Trap donations) with interactive modal details and badges
v2.9.25: Added interactive Batched Members Modal with copy button for seamless mobile and desktop inspection of grouped actions
v2.9.24: Added hover tooltip with numbered member names list to the orange batched pill in Admin Logs
v2.9.23: Redesigned Admin Action Audit Logs table layout, semantic category badges, and batch summaries
